CVE-2025-3576.title: A vulnerability in the MIT Kerberos implementation allows GSSAPI- ...
CVE-2025-3576.description: A vulnerability in the MIT Kerberos implementation allows GSSAPI-protected messages using RC4-HMAC-MD5 to be spoofed due to weaknesses in the MD5 checksum design. If RC4 is preferred over stronger encryption types, an attacker could exploit MD5 collisions to forge message integrity codes. This may lead to unauthorized message tampering.

CVE-2026-107708.title: MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulne ...
CVE-2026-107708.description: MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the KDC's get_pac_princ_with_realm() that returns success while leaving the client principal NULL on malformed names. A malicious or compromised cross-realm trusted KDC can send an S4U2Proxy request with a PAC carrying a malformed client name to crash krb5kdc and deny authentication.

CVE-2026-107778.title: MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dere ...
CVE-2026-107778.description: MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API acceptor services, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-107884.title: krb5: Unauthorized key reset of protected principal via kpasswd
CVE-2026-107884.description: In MIT krb5 release 1.15 and later, a client with kadmin administrative privileges can bypass the lockdown_keys attribute by using the password change protocol instead of the kadmin protocol.

CVE-2026-112314.title: clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) ...
CVE-2026-112314.description: clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free the RPC reply verifier between retries, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak in GSS-RPC client programs) by injecting RPC replies with mismatched XIDs or by triggering authentication retries.

CVE-2026-112315.title: The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c  ...
CVE-2026-112315.description: The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and later do not free partially decoded buffers on failure, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPCSEC_GSS messages.

CVE-2026-112316.title: xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT Kerberos 5  ...
CVE-2026-112316.description: xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free partially decoded data on failure, which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger a decode failure.

CVE-2026-112317.title: krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka ...
CVE-2026-112317.description: krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.2.8 and later does not free decrypted key material when a post-decryption check fails, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak in the KDC or kadmind) via requests that repeatedly trigger key decryption failures.

CVE-2026-112318.title: The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-112318.description: The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a policy request with an empty policy name that reaches authorization checks or logging code.

CVE-2026-112319.title: The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not enforce s ...
CVE-2026-112319.description: The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded memory allocations during XDR decoding.

CVE-2026-112320.title: The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and  ...
CVE-2026-112320.description: The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP connection. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by repeatedly establishing and abandoning GSS authentication contexts.

CVE-2026-112321.title: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-112321.description: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments on certain error paths, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger authentication failures.

CVE-2026-112322.title: clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (ak ...
CVE-2026-112322.description: clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) restarts its scan from the head of the client list after each removal, resulting in quadratic CPU cost. Remote attackers can cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large number of AUTH_GSSAPI client entries.

CVE-2026-112323.title: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-112323.description: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests. Each failed request allocates client state that is only freed after a 15-minute expiration timeout, allowing an attacker to accumulate memory faster than it is reclaimed.

CVE-2026-118380.title: Important: krb5 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
CVE-2026-118380.description:
Kerberos is a network authentication system, which can improve the security of your network by eliminating the insecure practice of sending passwords over the network in unencrypted form. It allows clients and servers to authenticate to each other with the help of a trusted third party, the Kerberos key distribution center (KDC).  

Security Fix(es):  

  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory exhaustion via failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests (CVE-2026-112323)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated CPU DoS via AUTH_GSSAPI client states cleanup (CVE-2026-112322)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 GSS-RPC client memory leak on XID mismatch retries (CVE-2026-112314)
  * krb5: Unauthenticated KDC NULL pointer dereference KDC DoS via crafted PKINIT pre-auth request (CVE-2026-71200)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT error paths (CVE-2026-112321)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via GSS-RPC auth flavor switching (CVE-2026-112320)
  * krb5: Unauthorized key reset of protected principal via kpasswd (CVE-2026-107884)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory exhaustion DoS via unbounded RPC XDR allocation (CVE-2026-112319)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated DoS exploiting dereference of null policy name pointers (CVE-2026-112318)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated memory leak DoS in KDB keytab key decryption error path (CVE-2026-112317)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated CPU DoS via quadratic ASN.1 SEQUENCE OF decoding (CVE-2026-119079)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory leak DoS in xdr_krb5_tl_data() decode failure (CVE-2026-112316)
  * krb5: Improper authorization via flawed PAC checksum verification (CVE-2026-111423)
  * krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS in RPCSEC_GSS buffer decode failure (CVE-2026-112315)
  * krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via malformed PAC in S4U2Proxy requests (CVE-2026-107708)
  * krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via crafted forwarded credentials (CVE-2026-107778)
  * krb5: Alteration of authentication indicators in CAMMAC container (CVE-2026-71199)
  * krb5: kadmind: request alteration and protected information disclosure (CVE-2026-118380)
  * krb5: Unauthenticated KDC DoS based on ASN.1 decoder read overrun (CVE-2026-107364)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * Set PKINIT CMS signatureAlgorithm based on certificate public key type [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-278059)
  * auth_gssapi_wrap_data xdr_bytes failure leak [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296018)
  * xdr_bytes() does not free its allocation on partial decode failure [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296030)
  * RPCSEC_GSS context lifecycle leaks [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296039)
  * xdr_krb5_principal decode leak [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296051)
  * process_chpw_request leak [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296062)
  * Read overruns in GSSRPC svcauth_unix [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296073)
  * Null dereference in KDC dispatch corner case [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296085)
  * KDC DoS based on otherName value in PKINIT SAN code [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296103)
  * Memory leak on krb5 gss_accept_sec_context() failure [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296119)
  * KDC authdata filter does not catch KDC-issued types nested inside AD-IF-RELEVANT containers [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-296134)
  * Null dereference of principal names in krb5_rd_cred() [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-297007)
  * Dereference of empty first credential list element in GSS mechanism [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-297015)
  * Fix validation issues for trusted inputs [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299746)
  * Skip expired keys when iterating over KEYRING ccache [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299747)
  * Pass through null deleg_cred from SPNEGO to mech [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299748)
  * Fix leaks on error in PKINIT signed-data creation [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299749)
  * Fix hex key input handling in ktutil addent [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299750)
  * Check reply length before V4 reply check [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299751)
  * Fix memory leak in mpool_get() error paths [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299752)
  * json: Correctly abort parse on invalid array [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299753)
  * Prevent unsigned int overflow in iakerb_save_token() [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299754)
  * Fix ksu memory leak in fcmd_resolve() [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-299755)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

CVE-2026-119079.title: decode_sequence_of() in lib/krb5/asn.1/asn1_encode.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-119079.description: decode_sequence_of() in lib/krb5/asn.1/asn1_encode.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.11 and later grows the decoded element array one entry at a time, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in the KDC) by sending an unauthenticated AS-REQ or TGS-REQ with a large number of elements in a SEQUENCE OF field over TCP.

CVE-2026-40355.title: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22.3, there is a NULL point ...
CVE-2026-40355.description: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22.3, there is a NULL pointer dereference if an application calls gss_accept_sec_context() on a system with a NegoEx mechanism registered in /etc/gss/mech. An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger this, causing the process to terminate in parse_nego_message.

CVE-2026-40356.title: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22.3, there is an integer u ...
CVE-2026-40356.description: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22.3, there is an integer underflow and resultant out-of-bounds read if an application calls gss_accept_sec_context() on a system with a NegoEx mechanism registered in /etc/gss/mech. An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger this, possibly causing the process to terminate in parse_message.

CVE-2026-71199.title: krb5: Alteration of authentication indicators in CAMMAC container
CVE-2026-71199.description: In MIT krb5 release 1.14 and later (since authentication indicator support was added), an authenticated attacker can bypass authentication indicator requirements using an unkeyed checksum in the CAMMAC authdata container.

CVE-2025-3576.title: A vulnerability in the MIT Kerberos implementation allows GSSAPI- ...
CVE-2025-3576.description: A vulnerability in the MIT Kerberos implementation allows GSSAPI-protected messages using RC4-HMAC-MD5 to be spoofed due to weaknesses in the MD5 checksum design. If RC4 is preferred over stronger encryption types, an attacker could exploit MD5 collisions to forge message integrity codes. This may lead to unauthorized message tampering.

CVE-2026-107708.title: MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulne ...
CVE-2026-107708.description: MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the KDC's get_pac_princ_with_realm() that returns success while leaving the client principal NULL on malformed names. A malicious or compromised cross-realm trusted KDC can send an S4U2Proxy request with a PAC carrying a malformed client name to crash krb5kdc and deny authentication.

CVE-2026-107778.title: MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dere ...
CVE-2026-107778.description: MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API acceptor services, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-107884.title: krb5: Unauthorized key reset of protected principal via kpasswd
CVE-2026-107884.description: In MIT krb5 release 1.15 and later, a client with kadmin administrative privileges can bypass the lockdown_keys attribute by using the password change protocol instead of the kadmin protocol.

CVE-2026-112314.title: clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) ...
CVE-2026-112314.description: clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free the RPC reply verifier between retries, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak in GSS-RPC client programs) by injecting RPC replies with mismatched XIDs or by triggering authentication retries.

CVE-2026-112315.title: The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c  ...
CVE-2026-112315.description: The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and later do not free partially decoded buffers on failure, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPCSEC_GSS messages.

CVE-2026-112316.title: xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT Kerberos 5  ...
CVE-2026-112316.description: xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free partially decoded data on failure, which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger a decode failure.

CVE-2026-112317.title: krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka ...
CVE-2026-112317.description: krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.2.8 and later does not free decrypted key material when a post-decryption check fails, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak in the KDC or kadmind) via requests that repeatedly trigger key decryption failures.

CVE-2026-112318.title: The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-112318.description: The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a policy request with an empty policy name that reaches authorization checks or logging code.

CVE-2026-112319.title: The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not enforce s ...
CVE-2026-112319.description: The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded memory allocations during XDR decoding.

CVE-2026-112320.title: The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and  ...
CVE-2026-112320.description: The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP connection. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by repeatedly establishing and abandoning GSS authentication contexts.

CVE-2026-112321.title: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-112321.description: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments on certain error paths, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger authentication failures.

CVE-2026-112322.title: clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (ak ...
CVE-2026-112322.description: clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) restarts its scan from the head of the client list after each removal, resulting in quadratic CPU cost. Remote attackers can cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large number of AUTH_GSSAPI client entries.

CVE-2026-112323.title: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-112323.description: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests. Each failed request allocates client state that is only freed after a 15-minute expiration timeout, allowing an attacker to accumulate memory faster than it is reclaimed.
